items.title: AN ORDINANCE OF THE MAYOR AND CITY COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF MIAMI BEACH, FLORIDA, AMENDING CHAPTER 110 OF THE CODE OF THE CITY OF MIAMI BEACH, ENTITLED “UTILITIES,” BY AMENDING ARTICLE IV, ENTITLED “FEES, CHARGES, RATES AND BILLING PROCEDURE,” SECTION 110-166 THEREOF, ENTITLED “SCHEDULE OF MONTHLY WATER USER RATES AND TAPPING CHARGES,” TO GRANT AUTHORITY TO THE CITY MANAGER OR THEIR DESIGNEE TO IMPLEMENT ADDITIONAL PASS-THROUGH ADJUSTMENTS TO WATER USER RATES UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES AND TO DETERMINE APPLICABLE WATER USER RATES; BY AMENDING SECTION 110-168 THEREOF, ENTITLED “SCHEDULE OF MONTHLY SANITARY SEWER USER RATES,” TO GRANT AUTHORITY TO THE CITY MANAGER OR THEIR DESIGNEE TO IMPLEMENT ADDITIONAL PASS-THROUGH ADJUSTMENTS TO SANITARY SEWER USER RATES UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES AND TO DETERMINE APPLICABLE SANITARY SEWER USER RATES; AND FURTHER, BY AMENDING APPENDIX A TO THE CITY CODE, ENTITLED “FEE SCHEDULE,” TO INCREASE WATER RATES, SANITARY SEWER SERVICE CHARGES, AND STORMWATER FEES TO FUND THE CITY’S REVISED CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PLAN FOR WATER, SEWER, AND STORMWATER PROJECTS PREPARED PURSUANT TO RESOLUTION NO. 2026-34383; AND PROVIDING FOR CODIFICATION, REPEALER, SEVERABILITY, AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

AN ORDINANCE OF THE MAYOR AND CITY COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF MIAMI BEACH, FLORIDA, AMENDING CHAPTER 18 OF THE CODE OF THE CITY OF MIAMI BEACH, FLORIDA, ENTITLED "BUSINESS," BY AMENDING ARTICLE XV, ENTITLED "STREET PERFORMERS AND ART VENDORS," BY AMENDING SECTION 18-903, ENTITLED “ARTIST VENDOR CERTIFICATE REQUIREMENTS AND RULES,” BY AMENDING SUBSECTION (5) THEREOF, TO ADDITIONALLY ALLOW THE ISSUANCE OF ARTIST VENDOR CERTIFICATES FOR NON- EXPRESSIVE PRODUCTS TO ENUMERATED NONRESIDENTS WHO HELD A PAST VALID ARTIST VENDOR CERTIFICATE; AND PROVIDING FOR REPEALER, SEVERABILITY, CODIFICATION, AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.

WOLFSONIAN ARTS DISTRICT AMENDMENTS AN ORDINANCE OF THE MAYOR AND CITY COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF MIAMI BEACH, FLORIDA, AMENDING THE MIAMI BEACH RESILIENCY CODE, BY AMENDING CHAPTER 5, ENTITLED “OFF-STREET PARKING,” ARTICLE II, ENTITLED “VEHICLE PARKING, BICYCLE PARKING AND OFF-STREET LOADING REQUIREMENTS,” SECTION 5.2.4, ENTITLED “VEHICLE OFF-STREET PARKING REQUIREMENTS,” SECTION 5.2.4.1 THEREOF, ENTITLED “PARKING TIER 1,” TO REMOVE THE PARKING REQUIREMENT FOR MUSEUMS AND ART GALLERIES LOCATED WITHIN THE WOLFSONIAN ARTS DISTRICT; BY AMENDING CHAPTER 7, ENTITLED “ZONING DISTRICTS AND REGULATIONS,” ARTICLE V, ENTITLED “SUPPLEMENTARY DISTRICT REGULATIONS,” SECTION 7.5.2, ENTITLED “HEIGHT REGULATIONS EXCEPTIONS (SUPPLEMENTARY DISTRICT REGULATIONS),” SECTION 7.5.2.1 THEREOF, ENTITLED “HEIGHT REGULATION EXCEPTIONS AND ROOFTOP ADDITIONS,” TO PERMIT MULTI-STORY ROOFTOP ADDITIONS ON CERTAIN PROPERTIES LOCATED WITHIN THE WOLFSONIAN ARTS DISTRICT; AND PROVIDING FOR REPEALER, SEVERABILITY, CODIFICATION, AND AN EFFECTIVE DATE.
